i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n    printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n    printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\", \n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n    printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\n\n    printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    const double avgTime = duration.count() / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n    \n    printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(h_out, \"OutputVector\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), numRows);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n","numLines":262,"startLine":1,"totalLines":262}},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_016eEBf7Jc2fvUrysNTa4tVx","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. Block p consists of rows [bounds[p], bounds[p+1]).\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   rowDelimiters: CSR row delimiters, size dim+1\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   numParts:      number of blocks\n//   bounds:        output, size numParts+1\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid partitionRows(const index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t dim, const int numParts,\n                   std::vector<index_t>& bounds) {\n    const index_t nnz = rowDelimiters[dim];\n    bounds.assign(numParts + 1, dim);\n    bounds[0] = 0;\n    for (int p = 1; p < numParts; ++p) {\n        const auto target = static_cast<index_t>(static_cast<uint64_t>(nnz) * p / numParts);\n        bounds[p] = static_cast<index_t>(std::lower_bound(rowDelimiters, rowDelimiters + dim, target) - rowDelimiters);\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format on the host\n//   (OpenMP over rows). Each row is accumulated sequentially, so the result\n//   is independent of the thread count.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Kernel: spmvCsrKernel\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format on the <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of elements (size should be = n)\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(index_t* cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n, const index_t dim) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n    printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n    printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\", \n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n    printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\n\n    printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    const double avgTime = duration.count() / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n    \n    printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(h_out, \"OutputVector\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), numRows);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_018JLrpDHmNKTsojB81sdZok","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyncBKAZXFi7MaPWZ9FR","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"That's a regression: about 20 ms per iteration instead of 1.75 ms. The bug is in my design. With 16384 columns and sparsity 10, each row has about 1638 nonzeros, so a 2048-entry chunk spans only about one row. The block then processes its rows nearly one at a time and loses the row parallelism.\n\nThe fix that keeps the exact summation order is warp-per-row. Lanes read the row's nonzeros in coalesced 32-entry groups and form the products in parallel. Lane 0 then adds the products in row order. With `--fmad=false` each product is rounded and then added, exactly as the CPU loop does. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyncBKAZXFi7MaPWZ9FR","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01TJjoha8xMKBXJ9MfT3qkUS","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/spmv_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_hybrid_r2/spmv/spmv.cpp","old_string":"// ****************************************************************************\n// Kernel: spmvCsrKernel\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format on the GPU.\n//   One thread handles one row. The nonzeros of a block's rows are contiguous\n//   in CSR, so they are staged through shared memory in coalesced chunks; each\n//   row is still accumulated in the same order as spmvCpu, so the GPU result\n//   matches the host result.\n//\n// Arguments: see spmvCpu (dim is the number of local rows)\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\n__global__ void spmvCsrKernel(const double* __restrict__ val, const index_t* __restrict__ cols,\n                              const index_t* __restrict__ rowDelimiters,\n                              const double* __restrict__ vec, const index_t dim,\n                              double* __restrict__ out) {\n    __shared__ double sVal[SPMV_CHUNK];\n    __shared__ index_t sCols[SPMV_CHUNK];\n\n    const index_t row = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = row < dim;\n\n    const index_t blockFirstRow = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x;\n    const index_t blockLastRow = (blockFirstRow + blockDim.x < dim) ? blockFirstRow + blockDim.x : dim;\n    const index_t blockBegin = rowDelimiters[blockFirstRow];\n    const index_t blockEnd = rowDelimiters[blockLastRow];\n\n    index_t j = active ? rowDelimiters[row] : 0;\n    const index_t rowEnd = active ? rowDelimiters[row + 1] : 0;\n\n    double t = 0.0;\n    for (index_t base = blockBegin; base < blockEnd; base += SPMV_CHUNK) {\n        const index_t count = (blockEnd - base < SPMV_CHUNK) ? blockEnd - base : SPMV_CHUNK;\n\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (index_t k = threadIdx.x; k < count; k += blockDim.x) {\n            sVal[k] = val[base + k];\n            sCols[k] = cols[base + k];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Consume this row's nonzeros that fall inside the staged chunk, in order\n        if (active) {\n            const index_t chunkEnd = base + count;\n            for (; j < rowEnd && j < chunkEnd; ++j) {\n                t += sVal[j - base] * vec[sCols[j - base]];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        out[row] = t;\n    }\n}","new_string":"// ****************************************************************************\n// Kernel: spmvCsrKernel\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format on the GPU.\n//   One warp handles one row: the lanes read the row's nonzeros with coalesced\n//   loads and form the products in parallel. Lane 0 then adds the products in\n//   row order, exactly as spmvCpu does, so the GPU result is bit-identical to\n//   the host result (the GPU is built with --fmad=false to match).\n//\n// Arguments: see spmvCpu (dim is the number of local rows)\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\n__global__ void spmvCsrKernel(const double* __restrict__ val, const index_t* __restrict__ cols,\n                              const index_t* __restrict__ rowDelimiters,\n                              const double* __restrict__ vec, const index_t dim,\n                              double* __restrict__ out) {\n    __shared__ double sProd[THREADS_PER_BLOCK];\n\n    const unsigned warpInBlock = threadIdx.x / WARP_SIZE;\n    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x % WARP_SIZE;\n    const index_t row = blockIdx.x * (blockDim.x / WARP_SIZE) + warpInBlock;\n    if (row >= dim) {\n        return;  // Whole warp shares the row, so this exit is warp-uniform\n    }\n\n    double* prod = &sProd[warpInBlock * WARP_SIZE];\n    const index_t rowEnd = rowDelimiters[row + 1];\n    double t = 0.0;\n    for (index_t j0 = rowDelimiters[row]; j0 < rowEnd; j0 += WARP_SIZE) {\n        const index_t j = j0 + lane;\n        if (j < rowEnd) {\n            prod[lane] = val[j] * vec[cols[j]];\n        }\n        __syncwarp();\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            const index_t count = (rowEnd - j0 < WARP_SIZE) ? rowEnd - j0 : WARP_SIZE;\n            for (index_t k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n                t += prod[k];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncwarp();\n    }\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        out[row] = t;\n    }\n}"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":810,"cache_read_input_tokens":96725,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":810},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"e56929f1-404a-41f0-b642-ac24e1cf1803","uuid":"5f61f921-f52a-46f8-96f0-0c5b9a739d12","timestamp":"2026-10-13T06:47:17.175Z","request_id":"req_011CfyncAs8Xb6f3Bn4PG42d"}

rowDelimiters[row + 1] : 0;\n\n    double t = 0.0;\n    for (index_t base = blockBegin; base < blockEnd; base += SPMV_CHUNK) {\n        const index_t count = (blockEnd - base < SPMV_CHUNK) ? blockEnd - base : SPMV_CHUNK;\n\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (index_t k = threadIdx.x; k < count; k += blockDim.x) {\n            sVal[k] = val[base + k];\n            sCols[k] = cols[base + k];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Consume this row's nonzeros that fall inside the staged chunk, in order\n        if (active) {\n            const index_t chunkEnd = base + count;\n            for (; j < rowEnd && j < chunkEnd; ++j) {\n                t += sVal[j - base] * vec[sCols[j - base]];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        out[row] = t;\n    }\n}","newString":"// ****************************************************************************\n// Kernel: spmvCsrKernel\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format on the GPU.\n//   One warp handles one row: the lanes read the row's nonzeros with coalesced\n//   loads and form the products in parallel. Lane 0 then adds the products in\n//   row order, exactly as spmvCpu does, so the GPU result is bit-identical to\n//   the host result (the GPU is built with --fmad=false to match).\n//\n// Arguments: see spmvCpu (dim is the number of local rows)\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\n__global__ void spmvCsrKernel(const double* __restrict__ val, const index_t* __restrict__ cols,\n                              const index_t* __restrict__ rowDelimiters,\n                              const double* __restrict__ vec, const index_t dim,\n                              double* __restrict__ out) {\n    __shared__ double sProd[THREADS_PER_BLOCK];\n\n    const unsigned warpInBlock = threadIdx.x / WARP_SIZE;\n    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x % WARP_SIZE;\n    const index_t row = blockIdx.x * (blockDim.x / WARP_SIZE) + warpInBlock;\n    if (row >= dim) {\n        return;  // Whole warp shares the row, so this exit is warp-uniform\n    }\n\n    double* prod = &sProd[warpInBlock * WARP_SIZE];\n    const index_t rowEnd = rowDelimiters[row + 1];\n    double t = 0.0;\n    for (index_t j0 = rowDelimiters[row]; k < count; ++k) {\n                t += prod[k];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncwarp();\n    }\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        out[row] = t;\n    }\n}","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\nconstexpr unsigned THREADS_PER_BLOCK = 256;\nconstexpr unsigned SPMV_CHUNK = 2048; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyoKN1z3gsokCgKFvgZ4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The SpMV benchmark now runs as a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program. It still builds as `spmv`, and its results match the original exactly.\n\n**Results**\n\n- **Correctness:** The `-r` hash equals the original's for every case I ran: five matrix shapes, 1, 3 and 4 ranks, and `-v` passes each time. Changing the summation order or allowing GPU FMA would change the last bits, so the kernel keeps the original's per-row order and is built with `--fmad=false`.\n- **Performance** (n=16384, sparsity 10, per iteration):\n\n| Setup | Time | Throughput |\n|---|---|---|\n| Original (CPU, 1 process) | 41.8 ms | 1.28 GFLOPS |\n| 1 GPU | 1.75 ms | ~30 GFLOPS |\n| 3 GPUs | 0.88 ms | ~62 GFLOPS |\n\nThe 3-GPU run is 2× the single GPU, not 3×. I didn't dig into why.\n\n**Design**\n\n- **MPI:** Rank 0 generates the matrix and vector with the original random sequence, then scatters contiguous row blocks. Each block has a balanced nonzero count. The dense vector is broadcast. `-r` gathers the output to rank 0.\n- **CUDA:** Each rank binds one GPU, round-robin if ranks outnumber GPUs. The kernel is one thread per row.\n- **OpenMP:** Threads per rank are the node's cores divided by the ranks on that node. OpenMP rebases the row pointers and computes the `-v` reference on each rank's rows, so validation needs no gather. OpenMP does not compute the timed SpMV. A CPU share would be far slower than the GPU and would slow the whole run.\n- **CMake:** MPI, OpenMP and CUDA are all `REQUIRED`. `spmv.cpp` compiles as CUDA, with default architectures `70;75;80;86;89;90`, overridable with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`.\n\n**Tried and reverted:** I tried warp-per-row and shared-memory staging. Both kept the hashes but ran slower (3.9 ms and 20 ms per iteration). Unrolling made no measurable difference.\n\n**Limitations**\n\n- Matrix generation stays serial on rank 0. It replays the original `rand()` sequence, and it is excluded from timing, as in the original.\n- Matrices with more than `INT_MAX` (~2.1 billion) nonzeros abort, because MPI counts are `int`. The original's `numRows*numRows` also overflows `uint32` from about 65536 rows, and I left that as it was.\n- I didn't test the failing-validation path, and I only ran on this single node with 3 RTX 3090s. Multi-node runs are untested.\n\nI did not touch `output.txt` or create any new project files. The project is not a git repo, so I did not commit."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2071,"cache_read_input_tokens":115972,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2071},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"e56929f1-404a-41f0-b642-ac24e1cf1803","uuid":"b30e9e93-6f9a-4244-b440-c1b627c6c599","timestamp":"2026-10-13T06:56:13.501Z","request_id":"req_011CfyoKMhtoVM9G57E21KSg"}
